overclaims: Two relevant Reuters republications could not be read with the required reader.
checks.note: The e1 public excerpt 'the platform will be wound down.' drops the condition in the source, 'If such a bid is unavailable, however,'. On its own it reads as a definite shutdown, which misstates the Character.ai disclosure. The limitations also call both unread 403 pages 'relevant Reuters republications'. The packet never says either page is Reuters, and one has a different headline, so this is unverified. Dates, outcome and horizon are correct otherwise.

The excerpt is exact. e8 supports widening for all eight matched borrowers from Oct 8 to 15 (median 334 to about 413 bp, JNK moved 1 bp). e9 gives 5.09% on Oct 16 and 5.15% on Oct 19, both above 5% in the period. e10 links the repricing to execution and return risk and limits the universal reading. The limits are disclosed: secondary Treasury source, marginal-cost reading, no realized-profit measure. Citations and dates are correct, and causal_assessment/not_applicable/supported matches the agreed assessment.
